verdict.rationale: Reflect is a note-taking SaaS, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an MCP server, hosted or local. The OAuth REST API and the OpenAPI spec on openpm are developer building blocks someone could use to build an MCP server, not an official one, and the AI palette and note chat are in-app features, so none of this earns credit.
